basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas, who loves to combine my passion for technology with a healthy lifestyle. During the day, I'm coding away for a tech startup, and in my spare time, I dive into video games and YouTube content, especially those of creators like Cody Ko and Brownman. I'm a foodie at heart, always looking for ways to integrate nutritious eating with my love for comfort food. I'm single and enjoy exploring the local Austin food scene with friends. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 6 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been working in tech for over seven years. My interest in healthy living led me to self-teach intuitive eating principles through books and online courses.
